issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but has no corresponding implementation bead. Add `verifies` as a third dependency kind so authors can declare the check relationship, and diagnose (report only — never reject at insert, never infer from titles) any `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead, surfacing the affected ids and the remediating edge in doctor/policy-lint output. Tests must cover: a plain inverted pair, a two-node pair that is simultaneously cycle and inversion (cycle rejection must still fire), the legitimate declared 'prove baseline green first' gate, and titles containing verification nouns that must not trigger inference. Update the §3.4 kind set, schema, and capabilities docs in the same change.

Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
